live.pageSubtitle: Record a broadcast, watch the room in real time, and keep the summary when the stream ends.

hero.idleSubtitle: Start a simulated stream to see how LiveMemory records chat, gifts and viewers — or connect to a Bilibili or YouTube broadcast that is live right now.
hero.startFailed: The simulated stream could not start.

chart.title: Message density
chart.hint: Bucket size adapts to the session length
chart.empty: The chart appears as soon as messages arrive.

feed.title: Recent activity
feed.empty: Messages, gifts and Super Chats will appear here.

source.title: Live source
source.hint: The simulator lets you try the recording flow; Bilibili and YouTube connect to real live broadcasts (live only).
source.mockNote: Simulated events only verify the recording flow; they are not real platform data.
source.loginAnonymous: Not signed in (public chat works anonymously)
source.loginExpired: The QR code expired. Open the sign-in page again
source.anonymousNote: Public chat, gifts and Super Chats work without signing in. Signing in does not change viewer identity fields.
source.moneyNote: Amounts follow the platform: gifts at 1000 gold coins = ¥1, Super Chats quoted in yuan, and guard prices stay unbooked because their unit is unconfirmed.
source.identityNote: Viewer identity uses the platform UID. Nicknames may be masked by the platform (e.g. “电***”); they are never guessed or merged.
source.loginScanHint: Scan the QR code below with the Bilibili mobile app and confirm on your phone. The code is generated locally; no external page is opened.
source.loginQrUnavailable: Could not render the QR code. Reload the page and try again.
source.youtubeIntro: Paste the link of a YouTube broadcast that is live right now, or its video ID. Only live broadcasts are supported — uploaded videos and comments are never fetched.
source.youtubeModeAnonymous: Public broadcast mode: an application API key reads public chat, no sign-in needed
source.youtubeModeOAuth: Signed in with a Google account
source.youtubeNotConfiguredTitle: YouTube is not configured in this build
source.youtubeNotConfiguredBody: This build contains no developer credentials. The maintainer has to set up a Google Cloud project and an OAuth client once (or provide an API key used only for public data). Streamers never create a key themselves.
source.youtubeLoginWaiting: Finish the Google consent in your browser; you will come back here automatically.
source.youtubeLoginFailed: Sign-in did not complete. Please try again
source.youtubeLoginHint: The system browser opens Google's own consent page and returns to a 127.0.0.1 callback on this PC. LiveMemory never sees your Google password.
source.youtubeNoChat: Chat is disabled for this broadcast
source.youtubePolicyBody: YouTube's developer policies limit how long public chat data may be kept. Chat text is deleted automatically after {days} days; message counts, viewer identity and support totals are kept.
source.youtubeAutoEnded: The broadcast ended. The recording is saved

history.pageSubtitle: Every recorded broadcast, with local statistics that do not depend on any AI service.
history.emptyBody: Start a recording on the Live page. Finished sessions are kept here with their statistics and timeline.

detail.supportEmpty: No paid events in this session.
detail.aiPendingBody: Export an AI analysis package and give it to any AI service to add topics, sentiment shifts and clip suggestions.
detail.simulatedNote: This session contains simulated data used to verify the recording pipeline.
detail.interruptedNote: This session was interrupted (the app closed unexpectedly). Its statistics are kept as recorded.

viewers.pageSubtitle: Long-term profiles built from stable platform identities. Nickname changes never split a person in two.
viewers.emptyBody: Viewers appear here once they speak or send support during a recorded session.

detail.interestsEmpty: Interests are added by an imported AI profile update (milestone M7). Until then only local facts are shown.
detail.notes: LiveMemory shows facts it recorded. How you use them is entirely your decision.

ai.pageSubtitle: No API keys and no cloud connection. Give the package to any AI service that supports file upload and structured output, then import the answer.

steps.exportDesc: Build one .zip with messages, aggregates, platform emote names, AI instructions and the result schema.
steps.promptDesc: Upload the package and send the AI analysis instructions.
steps.importDesc: Validate the JSON answer and merge it into the console.

export.title: Export AI analysis package
export.hint: The archive contains the chat log, session statistics, viewer context, the platform emote dictionary, the localized AI instructions and the JSON schema. No cookies or tokens are included.
export.empty: Record a session first — there is nothing to analyse yet.

prompt.title: AI analysis instructions
prompt.hint: The same text is inside the package as instructions.md.

import.title: Import the AI result
import.body: Import and schema validation arrive in milestone M6. Until then the package already contains the exact schema so you can inspect the answer by hand.

task.title: What the AI will analyse
task.topics: The topics discussed across the session and how they changed
task.timeline: How discussion shifted over time and which periods were most active
task.existingViewers: New information, interest changes and profile updates for existing viewers
task.emoji: Text, Unicode emoji and platform emote names; unknown emotes are marked explicitly and never guessed.
task.serviceTitle: Use the AI service you choose
task.serviceBody: LiveMemory is not tied to any AI brand. You can use any AI service that supports file upload and structured output. File size, ZIP support and context length differ between services.

settings.pageSubtitle: Language, appearance and storage. Preferences are saved on this computer and survive restarts.

language.title: Language
language.desc: Used by the web console and by the launcher console window.
language.note: Chat messages are never translated; AI reports follow the analysis language you choose.

theme.title: Appearance
theme.desc: Light and dark are designed separately for comfortable contrast.
theme.hint: Follow system switches automatically when Windows changes theme.

storage.title: Storage mode
storage.desc: Controls how long raw chat text is kept. Totals and profiles are always kept.
storage.compactDesc: Raw chat is kept until an analysis import is verified, then the text is purged while counts, viewers and payments remain.
storage.fullDesc: Raw chat and events are kept indefinitely so sessions can be re-analysed later.
storage.note: Automatic purging is part of M4/M6; in this build nothing is deleted automatically.

data.title: Your data
data.desc: Everything lives in a folder you own. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
data.backupBody: Portable .livememory backup and restore arrive in milestone M5. Today you can copy the data folder while LiveMemory is closed.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Cannot reach the local LiveMemory server. Is the console window still running?
errors.sessionEmpty: This session has no messages to analyse yet.
errors.sessionActive: A session is already being recorded.
errors.sessionNotActive: That session is not being recorded.
errors.settingsInvalid: That setting value is not valid.
errors.invalidJson: The request body was not valid JSON.
errors.eventInvalid: An event could not be read and was skipped.
errors.jsonRequired: A JSON request body is required.
errors.portUnavailable: No free local port was available.
errors.bilibiliAuth: Bilibili requires a signed-in account for this action. Please sign in by QR.
errors.bilibiliNetwork: Could not reach Bilibili. Check the network and try again.
errors.bilibiliError: Bilibili returned a response this app cannot handle.
errors.roomNotFound: That live room was not found. Check the room ID.
errors.roomIdInvalid: The live room ID must be numeric.
errors.youtubeApi: YouTube returned a response this app cannot handle. Try again later.
errors.youtubeNetwork: Could not reach YouTube. Check the network and try again.
errors.youtubeAuthRequired: Sign in with a Google account before reading the live chat.
errors.youtubeAuthExpired: The Google authorization expired. Please sign in again.
errors.youtubeApiKeyInvalid: The YouTube API key is invalid or the YouTube Data API is not enabled.
errors.youtubeQuota: The YouTube API quota is exhausted. Try again later or tomorrow.
errors.youtubeRateLimit: Too many YouTube requests. Slowing down and retrying.
errors.youtubeForbidden: This broadcast cannot be read with the current credentials.
errors.youtubeVideoNotFound: That video was not found. Check the link or video ID.
errors.youtubeNotLive: That link is not a live broadcast. LiveMemory records live only and never analyses uploaded videos.
errors.youtubeUpcoming: This broadcast has not started yet. Record it once it is live.
errors.youtubeEnded: This broadcast already ended, so its live chat cannot be recorded.
errors.youtubeChatDisabled: Chat is disabled for this broadcast.
errors.youtubeChatUnavailable: The live chat for this broadcast could not be found. It may have been closed.
errors.youtubeLinkInvalid: Enter a YouTube live link or an 11-character video ID.
errors.youtubeNotConfigured: YouTube is not configured: the maintainer's one-time OAuth client or API key is missing.
errors.youtubeLoginDenied: You denied the authorization on the Google page.
errors.youtubeLoginTimeout: Timed out waiting for the authorization. Please sign in again.
errors.youtubeLoginFailed: The authorization result was invalid. Please sign in again.
errors.youtubeClientInvalid: The OAuth client configuration is invalid. Contact the maintainer.
